measurement.arms: production selects the WMMA variant for the sliding layers; strict is the recorded pre-existing path and is unchanged by this work
measurement.baseline_reproduction: The strict arm reproduces the previously recorded ladder (870.4 / 704.3 / 567.8 / 453.9) within 2 percent at every point, which is what makes the two arms comparable.
measurement.reading: At 512 tokens the engine now matches the reference (1012.8 against 1012.98). At 4096 the gap falls from 2.29x to 1.66x. The isolated kernel is 13.64x and the end-to-end gain is 1.38x; the attenuation is arithmetic rather than a shortfall, since the sliding layers are about 52 percent of attention FLOPs, attention was 61 percent of the step, and the production path is chunked at 512 rows against a growing KV rather than the bench's single 4096-row launch. 0.683 + 0.317/13.6 = 0.706, i.e. 1.42x, against 1.38x measured.

numerical.screen: All 12 greedy generations (4 prompt lengths x 3 samples, 128 tokens each) are token-identical between the strict and production arms.
numerical.not_the_gate: This is a screen, not the docs/EXECUTION-PROFILES.md section 6 production numerical gate. That gate wants full-vocabulary teacher-forced rows with a KL envelope (mean <= 1e-3, p95 <= 5e-3, p99 <= 2e-2, max <= 5e-2, top-1 >= 99% overall and >= 97% per scope). The route is a T2 association candidate (WMMA accumulation order, FP16 rounding of the softmax weights before the P*V dot) and that gate is what its promotion evidence is made of. Owed and recorded in docs/REFACTOR.md; the rollback lever is HIPENGINE_EXECUTION_PROFILE=strict.

not_verified: Token identity is over 128-token greedy rows on one prompt corpus; it is not a distributional statement.
No repeatability study across GPU clock states, thermal states or reboots. Each point is three samples after one warmup.
The head_dim-512 full layers are still the strict kernel, still 5 of 30 layers at 427.9 GFLOP/s. They are the other half of the attention FLOPs and are most of the remaining 1.66x gap at 4096 tokens.
